q1_issues.issue: (Member quartet group) types the referent out of its own name — the text supplies no kind word for the Quartet, and Names and casing forbids reading a genus off a name.
The definite head noun of 'the question of whether ...' is dropped — no question witness and no (Of <question> (Whether ...)); the sealed Whether term is hung directly on the state's On oblique.

'the Palestinian people' is a nationality-adjective + noun pair, which Compound concepts says to fuse into one kind with its genus atoms, not split into (Member sk_people_1 people) + (Member sk_people_1 palestinian).
'the rest' of a count whole should take the (GroupOf ...) + (SubsetOf ...) portion of Partitives; the parse uses the mass/heterogeneous PartOf route instead.

q2_gaps: a split-ratio adverbial ('divided three-to-one') — no licensed encoding for the ratio itself
a verbless absolute phrase naming the sides of a split ('the United States against the rest')
a question-denoting noun taking an embedded question as its complement ('the question of whether P') — Embedded questions covers only a verb's sealed Theme
notes: (Cardinality sk_rest_1 3) is inferred from 'three-to-one' plus the US being the singleton side — defensible, and the only trace of the ratio. Deontic 'should' has no strength carrier inside a seal, so the bare (Obligated sk_treat_1) conjunct is not counted as a defect.
